Want a fitness tracker you actually control?
 
openGym is an open-source, self-hosted workout tracker for planning routines, logging sets, tracking body weight, and monitoring progress.
 
Your data stays on your server  no subscription, ads, or telemetry. Supports passkeys, offline use, sync, Docker, and a standalone Android APK.
 
More details & alternatives: https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/opengym.html
 
#OpenSource #SelfHosting #Privacy #Fitness #FOSS #Docker
